This suggests that there may be underlying issues affecting the company's ability to grow its revenue. In conclusion, while Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd (CROMPTON) appears to have strong fundamentals with high P/E and P/B ratios, it also faces significant challenges in terms of profitability and sales growth. This creates a compelling case for further investigation into the company's financial health and growth prospects to determine if the current valuation is justified.]
